overall_goal: Perform various kitchen tasks including washing hands, adding potatoes to the frying pan, cleaning up potato peels, and storing ingredients

goals.description: Wash a wooden spoon and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person washes a wooden spoon under the tap, places it in the cutlery stand, and dries their hands.

goals.description: Rearrange kitchen items and retrieve potatoes
goals.rationale: The person moves a large bowl and colander, hangs a cloth on the cupboard, and picks up a bag of potatoes.
The person washes and dries their hands after handling items.

goals.description: Put down peeled potato and peeler, wash hands, and adjust items
goals.rationale: The person places a peeled potato and peeler down, washes their hands to remove starch, hangs the cloth, and adjusts the chopping board.

goals.description: Prepare utensils and ingredients for chopping and frying
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a frying pan, hangs a cloth, picks up a knife, turns on the extractor hood light, and grabs a potato.

goals.description: Add potato chunks to the frying pan and move items
goals.rationale: The person drops potato chunks into the frying pan, distributes them, and moves a colander and bag of potatoes.

goals.description: Put down peeled potato and peeler, then wash and dry hands
goals.rationale: The person puts down a peeled potato and peeler, then washes and dries their hands to remove potato starch.

goals.description: Add remaining potato chunks to the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person drops the remaining potato chunks into the frying pan and distributes them evenly.
The person washes their hands to remove potato starch, dries them, and hangs the cloth back.

goals.description: Close olive oil can and turn on the hob
goals.rationale: The person closes the olive oil can, puts it down, and turns on the hob to start frying the potatoes.

goals.description: Prepare cooking utensils and turn on extractor fan
goals.rationale: The person picks up a spatula, moves a glass lid, grabs salt, turns on the extractor fan, and rests the spatula.

goals.description: Take out the food waste bin and start collecting potato peels
goals.rationale: The person takes the food waste bin out of the cupboard, opens it, and begins collecting potato peels from the kitchen top.

goals.description: Continue collecting potato peels and put the bin away
goals.rationale: The person finishes collecting potato peels, throws them into the bin, closes it, and puts it back into the cupboard.
The person washes and dries their hands after handling potato peels, then turns down the hob heat and puts down the spatula.

goals.description: Store the bag of potatoes in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person seals the bag of potatoes and places it on the bottom shelf of the fridge.
